Methodology

The 5 Non-Negotiable Laws of High Conversion

Every landing page we deploy follows our proprietary conversion heuristics, backed by over 450+ multivariate tests.

01

The 3-Second Hook Rule

A visitor decides whether to stay or bounce in less than 3 seconds. The hero must answer: What is this? Why should I care? And what is the immediate proof?

02

Frictionless Modal Forms

Instead of forcing visitors onto intimidating multi-page barriers, we use low-friction, high-intent pop-ups triggered smoothly by high-value offers like audits.

03

Message Match Continuity

If your ad says "Cut Google Ads CPA by 50%", your landing page headline must echo that exact promise verbatim to prevent cognitive dissonance.

04

Proof Density Stacking

We scatter trust anchors across every scroll viewport: real client logos, verifiable revenue screenshots, video explanations, and client metrics.

05

Server-Side First-Party CAPI

Bypassing iOS privacy restrictions and ad blockers with direct server-side signal delivery so Meta and Google feed the algorithm 100% accurate buyer signals.
